catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Local name of the catalog the library came from.

version.title: Version
version.description: Version the listed nodes would be moved to.

installed_version.title: Installed Version
installed_version.description: Version recorded in the project's own copy of the library manifest.

workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

workflow_name.title: Workflow Name
workflow_name.description: Name of the workflow containing the node.

version.title: Version
version.description: Library version this node is currently pinned to.

outdated.title: Outdated
outdated.description: True when the pinned version is older than the target version.

running.title: Running
running.description: True when the runtime has this node starting, running, or stopping - it cannot be updated until it is stopped. Always false when the runtime could not be reached.

template_linked.title: Template Linked
template_linked.description: True when the node follows a catalog adapter. Its library pins come from the adapter release, so it is updated by updating the node from its catalog rather than here.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Every node in the project pinned to this library.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Every accessible project holding this catalog's copy of the library, with its dependent nodes.

inaccessible_projects.title: Inaccessible Projects
inaccessible_projects.description: How many further projects hold this library but were left out because the caller does not collaborate on them.

runtime_available.title: Runtime Available
runtime_available.description: False when the runtime could not be reached, in which case no node could be checked for being active and `running` is false throughout.
